arguments.description: Create one static 16x16 pixel-art Ready status icon for successful queue completion, on a transparent background. Propose a simple clear completion check silhouette as this first representative sample, distinct in shape from activity, error/retry, and pause symbols without relying on color alone. Use a cool blue UI accent, with existing UI accent #70b9ed as a color cue rather than a mandatory exact palette. Make the silhouette and pixel clusters readable at native 1x and 3x nearest-neighbor scale on dark panel #172336. This is a proposed style sample, not an approved style. One frame only; no animation.
